clue.text: Fellow's going after quiet drink

explanation.surface: A man follows a quiet spell with a drink at the bar.
explanation.walkthrough: SHANDY is beer mixed with lemonade, a British pub drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A shandy is a pub drink of beer mixed with lemonade.

clue.text: Bridge player covering up queen and ace

explanation.definitionFit: Ace and super are both informal words for excellent.

clue.text: Unconventional story of worker in East End slum

clue.text: Idiot has regularly dropped notes

explanation.definitionFit: In tonic sol-fa doh is the first note of the scale, so the plural gives musical notes.

clue.text: One can discriminate at mealtimes, but eats junk food in the end

clue.text: A union leader fronts mass meeting, so we hear

clue.text: Receiver of top-selling records I've allowed to be circulated?

clue.text: Cereal's eaten with cooked meat dish

clue.text: Fruit, old variety

clue.text: Band singer in group covers
